column1: # Values for the whole project for the 18S data. From the data record's ReadMe: the assay, gene and
# region. From the 10 L BioSample sheet (file 1), where they are the same for every sample: the three
# ENVO terms. The sample table's Sample type column gives samp_category (its six controls are
# libraries sequenced with the samples, not in the 18S table). From the
# methods (methods_consolidated.txt, sections 2 and 4): the rest, except the instrument, which is from
# the SRA run table (NextSeq 1000; B. Deagle, 6 November 2026). Details that differ between the 2 L
# and 10 L samples (filter, processing, extraction) are columns of the sample table instead.
# The protocols are links to the Australian Microbiome SOPs (13 November 2026). The methods say the 18S
# V4 region was tag-sequenced using meth_5.1, but the SOP site lists meth_5.1 as Amplicon Analysis (the
# bioinformatics), and meth_4.1.4 as the 18S V4 PCR with these primers: so nucl_acid_amp is meth_4.1.4
# and sop_bioinformatics meth_5.1, for the authors to confirm.
